title: A non-executable `--mmseqs-path` is reported as mmseqs missing from the system path
body:
`check_mmseqs_installed` (nail/src/util.rs) runs `<path> -h` and on failure reports `mmseqs2 does not appear to be in the system path`. When `--mmseqs-path` names a file that is not executable, the user sees that message and `Permission denied`, with no path. The input survey on nail-d551f7 ran this against the release binary.

## Proposal

The message names the path nail tried, and mentions the system path only when the user gave no `--mmseqs-path`.
close_reason: check_mmseqs_installed names the path it ran, and mentions the system path only for a bare name. Committed on dev.
